Share several files under one link. Pick or drop multiple files and they upload as one zero-knowledge bundle; the recipient gets the original files back individually (no zip). The server still only ever sees one opaque encrypted blob.

## Added

- **Multi-file upload.** Select or drag several files at once. With 2+ files featherdrop packs them into a single end-to-end-encrypted blob — a manifest plus the file contents, all inside the existing libsodium stream — and shares them under one link. A single file behaves exactly as before.
- **Multi-file download.** The share page lists the files (name + size) and offers **Download all** (each saved with its original name) and, on Chromium over HTTPS, **Save to folder** (writes them all into a folder you pick, via the File System Access API). Large bundles stream straight to disk; bundles up to 100 MB also get per-file download buttons.

## Notes

- Zero-knowledge is unchanged: the server never learns the file names, types, count, or contents — it stores one opaque blob. Password and link modes, expiry, and the download limit all apply to the bundle as a single unit.
- A single dropped folder is never expanded; only the files you pick are bundled.
